title: Part 1 enum field extraction answer
description: Structured-decoding contract for the two Part-1 menu fields (formation_structure, asset_class). Same shape as a Part-2 enum answer; kept as its own field-type so Part 1 is extracted in an independent pass (D14) and its prompt can inject the D13 decision framing rather than a Part-2 menu.

value.description: The chosen menu token, or null when answered=false.

quote.description: Verbatim span supporting the value; required when answered=true.
